task.description: Gate review on commits ddfa3cdf/bc90819b (branch feature/WF03-ISS0768-20260921), which add opts[:prefix] threading to Letflow.Identity.RoleRegistry's list_roles/1, upsert_role/3, do_upsert_role/3, insert_or_update_role/3 (via Repo.all/Repo.transaction/Repo.get/Repo.insert), and update routers/identity.ex's handle_list_roles/2 and handle_upsert_role/2 to pass conn.assigns.scoped_opts. Check against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md INV-1..INV-8. This is a tenant-data write/read path (role management) so this gate is mandatory before REVIEWER. Specifically verify: (1) every Repo call in the touched functions genuinely receives prefix: from opts, no call silently reverts to the default/public schema, (2) resolve_role_in_tx/1 is genuinely untouched (diff-confirm), (3) the router changes correctly derive scoped_opts the same way every other tenant-scoped route in that router does — no new bypass, (4) a role created under one tenant's prefix cannot be read back under a different prefix (read the new regression test to confirm it actually asserts this, not just that the happy path works).
acceptance_criteria: PASS or FAIL verdict with specific findings against INV-1..INV-8
Confirms every touched Repo call receives prefix: by reading the actual diff, not the design doc alone
Confirms resolve_role_in_tx/1 is byte-for-byte untouched by diffing against origin/main
Confirms the new test genuinely proves cross-tenant isolation (not just single-tenant happy path)
If FAIL: precise, actionable findings for ELIXIR-DEV rework (do not fix it yourself)
